issue.title: Flaky test_run_supervisor_idle_timeout_fires_after_output_stalls exceeds 5s no-hang bound
issue.description:
tests/monitor/test_monitor_supervise.py::test_run_supervisor_idle_timeout_fires_after_output_stalls failed under an escalated full just check (workspace sase_19, 2026-08-16, 6 xdist workers, 31161 items) with:

  assert 5.825556540999969 < 5.0
  at `assert elapsed < _NO_HANG_TIMEOUT`

The supervisor DID fire the idle timeout (`exit_status == 1` passed). The child is `sh -c 'echo started; sleep 30'` with `idle_timeout_seconds=0.2` and `timeout_seconds=30.0`. Under a contended full parallel lane the whole `run_supervisor()` call took 5.83s against `_NO_HANG_TIMEOUT = 5.0`.

This session did not touch monitor supervision or that test file — it only added reserved `lease(...)` RUNNING-field labels. Isolated rerun of the session's own tests passed (38 passed).

SCOPE: reproduce under a contended full parallel lane. The idle-timeout contract itself held; the flake is the 5.0s wall-clock bound around a 0.2s idle timeout. Related but not the same defect as closed sase-lk (different nodes whose pipe does not EOF promptly).
